title: duel
summary: Benilla defines the complete duel family with both ends byte-pinned: SMSG_DUEL_REQUESTED (arbiter+challenger guids), OUTOFBOUNDS/INBOUNDS (empty), COMPLETE (u8 started), WINNER (u8 + two cstrings), COUNTDOWN (u32 ms), and CMSG_DUEL_ACCEPTED/CANCELLED echoing the stored arbiter guid. MSUI has no duel opcode anywhere (not even in Net/Opcodes.cs); only incidental spell-error strings mention dueling.

openItems.text: SMSG_DUEL_REQUESTED / SMSG_DUEL_COUNTDOWN / SMSG_DUEL_INBOUNDS / SMSG_DUEL_OUTOFBOUNDS / SMSG_DUEL_COMPLETE / SMSG_DUEL_WINNER: no handlers
